text: Books without a rating sort last.

comments.text: The spec does not say where unrated books go, since rating is optional, and the design decides this without surfacing it. It is stated twice, in the design and in Task 2. Also, the design says the screen applies the sort over the sheet's rows while Task 2 sorts in the sheet, so the sort is duplicated and the two halves describe it differently. Pick one owner.
